prompt: What should a volunteer do with the previous card if both speakers eventually choose a different listening option for the long interview?
promptZh: 如果長訪談的兩位講述者後來都同意改用另一種聆聽方式，志工要怎麼處理原卡？

options.text: Cross out the original instruction and add the new agreement underneath.
options.zh: 劃掉原本的指示，在下面寫下新約定。
options.whyZh: 辦法說不可在原卡上覆寫；更改要另開新卡。

options.text: Keep the old card behind a dated replacement card showing the new decision.
options.zh: 在註有日期、記載新決定的新卡後面保留舊卡。
options.whyZh: 雙方同意後，給新卡寫日期，把舊卡留在後面；最新設定由頂端的有日期卡提供。

options.text: Throw away the old card once both speakers have approved the change.
options.zh: 兩位講述者都同意改變後就丟掉舊卡。
options.whyZh: 原卡要留在後方，不能因新設定確定就丟掉。

options.text: Keep the old card on top and change only the name printed on the recording.
options.zh: 把舊卡留在最上面，只改錄音上印的人名。
options.whyZh: 應在上方放新卡，而且錄音上印的姓名不決定播放方式。

explanationZh: 雙方同意後，給新卡寫日期，把舊卡留在後面；最新設定由頂端的有日期卡提供。
evidence: put the date on an updated card and keep the old card behind it / use the dated card on top

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: put the date on an updated card and keep the old card behind it
use the dated card on top
